selection_data: original train/validation only; no test labels
policy_rule: Prespecified essential anchors; preserve QC/population exclusions; optional imputation as fitted; empirical range/coverage reported as uncertainty, no unsupported fixed rejection thresholds. Alternative cuts are sensitivity analyses, not safety validation.

diabetes.gate_status: Research input contract; optional imputation and empirical support warnings; not clinically validated
diabetes.essential_rationale: Retain existing disease-specific anchor measurements and source population restriction.

kidney.gate_status: Research input contract; optional imputation and empirical support warnings; not clinically validated
kidney.essential_rationale: Require renal blood anchors creatinine and urea; urine variables were missing in training and remain optional under fitted imputation. This does not determine CKD chronicity.

breast_cancer.essential_rationale: Require total WBC and platelets as routine CBC anchors. Differential counts/ratios are optional because QC masks them during both fitting and inference; invalid counts remain withheld.
